verdict.rationale: Restate documents listening to webhooks and external signals and provides durable coordination primitives for external events (restate-docs-6, restate-docs-20), and services can be invoked over HTTP or via typed clients (restate-docs-8, restate-docs-9), which supports event-driven triggering of workflows. However, there is no evidence of a declarative trigger/binding system (e.g., queue or event-source config) or of a built-in fan-out mechanism where one event automatically dispatches to multiple functions — invocation appears to be point-to-point/service call based rather than pub/sub fan-out. Missing for 10: declarative event-trigger configuration, native queue/webhook source integrations, explicit one-to-many fan-out semantics.
